subject: Annual commitment invoicing cadence, netting, and monthly withdrawal playbook
messages:
From: Andrew Murphy <andrew.murphy@olivetech.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@olivetech.com, finance@olivetech.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Annual commitment — invoicing cadence and withdrawal / PO details

Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our finance team asked me to lock down the billing cadence for the annual committed spend so we can raise the PO and set up wire instructions. A few items we need to confirm from your side:

- Preferred invoice cadence (monthly vs quarterly) for a $1.2M annual commitment
- Whether Redwood will net usage credits against invoices or issue separate credit memos
- Template for monthly withdrawal / consumption reporting (CSV) so we can match to our ledger
- VAT evidence we should attach to each invoice for EU-sourced spend (we have cross-border operations)

Can you propose a simple playbook we can attach to our PO that outlines invoice timing, acceptance SLA, and remittance details? If you have a sample schedule we can initial, that would speed procurement.

Attached: none for this message.

Thanks,
Andrew Murphy
Head of Finance — Olive Tech
andrew.murphy@olivetech.com
+1 415-555-0192

---
IMPORTANT: Please include Redwood's bank wiring instructions and any required VAT IDs on the invoice to avoid payment delays.

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual commitment — invoicing cadence and withdrawal / PO details

Andrew —

Thanks, appreciate the detail. High level proposal below; I attached a one-page schedule + the XLS template for monthly reconciliation.

Quick proposal (we can adapt per your procurement needs):
- Invoice cadence: Monthly invoices (first invoice issued on 2027-07-01 covering access to reserved capacity and estimated monthly drawdown).
- Drawdown model: We will produce a monthly consumption file (CSV) by the 3rd business day of the following month. That file will be the source of truth for reconciliation.
- Netting/credits: We will net small usage credits (< $5k) on the next invoice. Anything larger will be issued as a separate credit memo and reflected in the subsequent invoice.
- Acceptance SLA: You have 10 business days from invoice + reconciliation file receipt to dispute; otherwise invoices auto-accept.
- VAT / remittance: See Kim's note (below) — we will include Redwood VAT/Tax ID on invoices and attach VAT evidence where required.
- PO: Please include the HubSpot deal id (DL-2027-OLV-19) and your PO number on invoice line 1.

Attachments: Redwood_Commitment_Schedule_2027.xlsx (one-page schedule + monthly CSV template)

Next steps:
1) If you confirm monthly cadence and netting behaviour, we will upload the schedule to DocuSign and return a signed copy for your PO.
2) Kim will confirm VAT evidence to include per country.

I can hop on a 20-min call if procurement wants to review the exact invoice layout.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com

Jonas — thanks, helpful. A couple of clarifying questions from our AP team:

1) If we net credits on the next invoice, will the remittance amount be the net amount on the invoice or do you require separate remittance for previously issued credit memos?
2) For EU spend: we operate through OliveTech EMEA (VAT ID: GB123456789). Do you support reverse-charge on Redwood invoices or do you need us to provide VAT certificates per country?

Procurement also asked if you can expose the monthly CSV on SFTP or via a secure link (we prefer SFTP for automation).

If you can confirm those 3 points, we'll provision the PO and route the DocuSign.

Thanks,
Andrew

Andrew —

Answers below from a tax/VAT perspective:

1) Netting behavior: We confirm that remittance should be the net amount shown on the invoice. Separate credit memos will be issued for > $5k adjustments but cash flow netting happens on the next invoice unless you'd like a separate wire.

2) EU VAT / Reverse charge: Redwood Inference can support reverse-charge treatment when the customer provides a valid VAT ID and confirms business-to-business purchase. For OliveTech EMEA (GB123456789) we will apply reverse charge on applicable invoices if you confirm which legal entity is the billing party. If any local EU country requires evidence beyond VAT ID we have a short evidence pack (VAT_Evidence_OliveTech.pdf) — attached.

3) CSV delivery: We can publish the monthly consumption CSV to a secure SFTP (preferred) or provide an expiring HTTPS link. Please provide SFTP host/account or confirm HTTPS is acceptable.

Please also confirm the remit-to bank used for the PO (we have two ledger entities for USD vs EUR). If you tell us which currency the PO is denominated in, we'll ensure the invoice bank details match.

Attachment: VAT_Evidence_OliveTech.pdf (stub)

Best,
Kimberly Park
VP, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
